PLAN "12-Week General Strength Program for Post-Herniation Client"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Build general strength with low spinal load"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Gait and safe strength 1":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x8..12 rpe 6
          bench_press 3x8..12 rpe 6
          dumbbell_row 3x8..12 rpe 6
          cable_row 3x8..12 rpe 6
          plank 3x30 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Posterior chain and core 1":
        warmup:
          jogging_in_place 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          hip_thrust 3x8..12 rpe 6
          goblet_squat 3x8..12 rpe 6
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 6
          lat_pulldown 3x8..12 rpe 6
          side_plank 3x30 seconds each side
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 2 minutes
      DAY Friday training 60m "Upper body push/pull 1":
        warmup:
          jump_rope 3 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 3x8..12 rpe 6
          dumbbell_press 3x8..12 rpe 6
          pull_up (assisted if needed) 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_extension 3x10..15 rpe 6
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 2 minutes
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Gait and safe strength 2":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x8..12 rpe 6
          bench_press 3x8..12 rpe 6
          dumbbell_row 3x8..12 rpe 6
          cable_row 3x8..12 rpe 6
          plank 3x30 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Posterior chain and core 2":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          hip_thrust 3x8..12 rpe 6
          goblet_squat 3x8..12 rpe 6
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 6
          lat_pulldown 3x8..12 rpe 6
          side_plank 3x30 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 2 minutes
      DAY Friday training 60m "Upper body push/pull 2":
        warmup:
          jumping_jack 2 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 3x8..12 rpe 6
          dumbbell_press 3x8..12 rpe 6
          pull_up 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_extension 3x10..15 rpe 6
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 2 minutes
  PHASE "Phase 2" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Strength progression 1":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x6..8 rpe 7
          bench_press 4x6..8 rpe 7
          dumbbell_row 4x6..8 rpe 7
          cable_row 4x6..8 rpe 7
          plank 4x35 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Posterior chain emphasis 1":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          hip_thrust 4x6..8 rpe 7
          goblet_squat 4x6..8 rpe 7
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 7
          lat_pulldown 4x6..8 rpe 7
          side_plank 3x40 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 2 minutes
      DAY Friday training 65m "Upper push/pull 1":
        warmup:
          jump_rope 3 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 4x6..8 rpe 7
          dumbbell_press 4x6..8 rpe 7
          pull_up 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_extension 4x8..12 rpe 7
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 2 minutes
    WEEK 6:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Strength progression 2":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x6..8 rpe 7
          bench_press 4x6..8 rpe 7
          dumbbell_row 4x6..8 rpe 7
          cable_row 4x6..8 rpe 7
          plank 4x40 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Posterior chain emphasis 2":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          hip_thrust 4x6..8 rpe 7
          goblet_squat 4x6..8 rpe 7
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 7
          lat_pulldown 4x6..8 rpe 7
          side_plank 3x40 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 2 minutes
      DAY Friday training 65m "Upper push/pull 2":
        warmup:
          jumping_jack 3 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 4x6..8 rpe 7
          dumbbell_press 4x6..8 rpe 7
          pull_up 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_extension 4x8..12 rpe 7
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 2 minutes
    WEEK 7:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Hypertrophy maintenance 1":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x10..12 rpe 7
          bench_press 3x10..12 rpe 7
          dumbbell_row 3x10..12 rpe 7
          cable_row 3x10..12 rpe 7
          plank 3x40 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Rotator cuff and mobility":
        warmup:
          jog_in_place 3 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 6
          external_rotation_band 3x15 rpe 5
          band_activated_wood_chop 3x10 each side rpe 5
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 2 minutes
      DAY Friday training 65m "Push/Pull volume 1":
        warmup:
          jump_rope 2 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 3x10..12 rpe 7
          dumbbell_press 3x10..12 rpe 7
          pull_up 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_extension 3x12..15 rpe 6
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 2 minutes
    WEEK 8:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Hypertrophy maintenance 2":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x10..12 rpe 7
          bench_press 3x10..12 rpe 7
          dumbbell_row 3x10..12 rpe 7
          cable_row 3x10..12 rpe 7
          plank 3x40 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Rotator cuff and mobility":
        warmup:
          jog_in_place 3 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 6
          external_rotation_band 3x15 rpe 5
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 2 minutes
      DAY Friday training 65m "Push/Pull volume 2":
        warmup:
          jump_rope 2 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 3x10..12 rpe 7
          dumbbell_press 3x10..12 rpe 7
          pull_up 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_extension 3x12..15 rpe 6
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 2 minutes

SYNTAX RULES:
- Rep ranges use TWO dots exactly as shown.
- Sets always come first in each line.
- RPE placed after reps.
- Rest times specified in seconds where provided.

EXERCISE VOCABULARY: (as listed)
push_up, pull_up, chin_up, dip, bench_press, incline_press, decline_press, dumbbell_press, shoulder_press, overhead_press, military_press, arnold_press, dumbbell_row, barbell_row, bent_over_row, cable_row, seated_row, lat_pulldown, cable_pulldown, bicep_curl, hammer_curl, concentration_curl, preacher_curl, tricep_dip, tricep_extension, tricep_pushdown, skull_crusher, face_pull, rear_delt_fly, lateral_raise, front_raise, dumbbell_fly, cable_fly, chest_fly, pec_deck, shrug, upright_row, squat, front_squat, goblet_squat, sumo_squat, split_squat, lunge, walking_lunge, reverse_lunge, lateral_lunge, deadlift, romanian_deadlift, sumo_deadlift, trap_bar_deadlift, leg_press, hack_squat, leg_curl, leg_extension, calf_raise, seated_calf_raise, standing_calf_raise, glute_bridge, hip_thrust, step_up, box_jump, jump_squat, hip_abduction, hip_adduction, good_morning, plank, side_plank, plank_up, crunch, bicycle_crunch, reverse_crunch, sit_up, v_up, russian_twist, wood_chop, leg_raise, hanging_leg_raise, lying_leg_raise, mountain_climber, dead_bug, bird_dog, ab_wheel, ab_rollout, hollow_hold, hollow_rock, toe_touch, pallof_press, superman, back_extension, jumping_jack, jump_rope, high_knees, butt_kicks, burpee, squat_jump, tuck_jump, arm_circles, leg_swings, hip_circles, ankle_circles, jog_in_place, marching, jumping_lunge, box_step, skater_jump, bear_crawl, crab_walk, inchworm, hamstring_stretch, quad_stretch, hip_flexor_stretch, calf_stretch, achilles_stretch, chest_stretch, shoulder_stretch, tricep_stretch, lat_stretch, back_stretch, spinal_twist, neck_stretch, neck_roll, butterfly_stretch, frog_stretch, pigeon_pose, child_pose, cat_cow, forward_fold, standing_forward_fold, figure_four_stretch, wrist_circles, ankle_rolls, turkish_getup, clean, clean_and_press, snatch, kettlebell_swing, thrusters, wall_ball, farmers_walk, suitcase_carry, battle_ropes, rowing

CARDIO MODALITIES: (as listed)
running, cycling, swimming, rowing, elliptical, jump_rope, walking, hiking

Notes for client constraints:
- No heavy spinal loading or loaded spinal flexion. Programming uses spinal-friendly movements: squat, hip hinge variations (hip_thrust, goblet_squat, leg press alternatives not used here), bench/floor-based pressing, rowing and pulling with braced core, and plank variations.
- If any exercise feels unsuitable, substitute with a safe alternative from the vocabulary with similar loading profile (e.g., replace loaded spinal flexion movements with braced core and hip hinge variations).
